The FloPlast 110mm push-fit soil and vent pipe bend provides a reliable solution for drainage installations. Constructed from durable and lightweight uPVC, this black 92.5° single socket bend offers strength and resilience, ideal for both new builds and renovation projects. Its push-fit connection and ring seal joints ensure swift and secure assembly for plumbers and general builders. Suitable for high temperature waste discharges, the design facilitates easy handling and installation. Applying silicone lubricant to the seals further enhances jointing efficiency, ensuring a robust and leak-proof soil pipe system.
